note: Three-way lymphoid split on a CD3 × CD19 plot. Tcells: T lymphocytes (both αβ and γδ) — large dense blob at the lower-right (CD3+, CD19-). Bcells: B lymphocytes — smaller cluster at the upper-left (CD3-, CD19+). CD3negCD19neg: non-B non-T fraction (NK cells, ILCs, monocytes, DCs, basophils — parsed downstream) — broad dense cluster sitting just left of the T-cell column and below the B-cell blob (CD3 negative-to-low, CD19 low-to-intermediate; the cluster sits above the (0,0) origin, not strictly at it). The double-positive upper-right corner is essentially empty.
tips: Three-way lymphoid split on a single CD3 × CD19 plot. Bcells: CD3- CD19+. Tcells: CD3+ CD19-. CD3negCD19neg: CD3- CD19-. Useful co-markers: CD20 (not in panel) would refine mature B cells; CD56_Lu175Di resolves NK from other CD3-CD19- subsets downstream; IgM_Yb174Di (in panel) could further refine mature vs naive B cells; HLA-DR_Yb176Di is expressed on B cells (APCs) and typically negative on resting T cells — useful as a positive confirmation for Bcells and a negative check for Tcells; CD7_Pr141Di is expressed on essentially all T cells (and NK) but not on B cells, reinforcing Tcells assignment within the CD3+CD19- polygon.
